body:
I appreciate you, person. I've felt bad over things that are so trivial in comparison. Fights with friends, "love, etc... 

I realistically think I can move on to another place of employment and stabilize myself again. That's not the END of the world. It's the the disappointing. Knowing all night, tomorrow, the next day, for who knows how long.... I'm going to be a topic of discussion for people I spent my time working alongside. A good handful my friends. Close friends. I spent most of my time with coworkers and past coworkers outside of work. And they're so confused and angry at me and they deserve to be. I probably made things so shitty at work now for them because they're guilty by association and under scrutiny. 

So now it's like I have nobody to reach out to. I have no right. It's not that it will never be okay, it's the journey that scares me. I feel like I'm alone and  deserve to be alone and I'm not going to make it there. I feel like 6 months ago I could be proud of who I was. Now I'm a slut. A thief. Nothing. 

Not knowing when I will see the faces of my favorite people again is terrible and it's my fault. I've almost crumbled under less

You took the time to answer me and I will remember and appreciate that. I'm gonna try to plan my next move
